said.quote: With improved business visibility, we have revised our FY '27 revenue growth guidance upwards to 26 – 30% from the earlier guidance of 24% to 27%.

claims.watch: First FY27 guidance 24–27%, raised to 26–30% in August after one quarter. On an FY26 base of ₹1,603 cr (their figure, May 2026 call p.5) that is ₹2,020–2,084 cr. Listen for whether the range moves again after Q2.

said.quote: On revenue guidance, we have previously committed to doubling revenues from FY24 to FY27, a target of approximately INR1,725 crores.
said.speaker: Kunhamed Bicha

claims.note: Management says this was committed earlier; the May 2026 call is the first of the calls read here where the ₹ figure is stated.
claims.watch: ₹1,725 cr for FY27. The 26–30% growth guidance on ₹1,603 cr implies ₹2,020–2,084 cr, so this older target is already inside the newer one; a miss here would mean a very large miss on the newer one.

said.quote: On our manufacturing footprint, our new manufacturing plant focused on domestic demand in Chennai is now complete and will commence commercial production from Q2 FY27.

claims.watch: Due in the quarter just reported. Listen for whether commercial production started by September and, if not, the new date.

said.quote: With that scale-up expected to happen in FY27, we see this trend of losses coming down and moving towards breakeven in later part of FY27.
